name: transferMoney
description: Transfer money between two distinct active accounts in the same currency; only execute an explicitly requested transfer

name: listAccountTransactions
description: List transactions and transfers involving an account UUID

name: createTransaction
description: Debit an active account after checking currency, balance and configured ceiling; only execute an explicitly requested debit

name: getTransaction
description: Get one bank transaction by its UUID

name: listAccounts
description: List all bank accounts and their identifiers

name: getAccount
description: Get an existing account, its status, currency and balance by UUID

name: getAccountBalance
description: Read the current balance and currency of a bank account by UUID
